design.joins: No fastened joints; ingredients are poured and stirred in the glass.
design.purpose: Serves 1: 50 ml Jägermeister over 2 ice cubes, topped with 150 ml orange juice, stirred and garnished with an orange slice.
design.standard: Highball glass 7 cm diameter, 14 cm tall; single 50 ml spirit serve
design.stands: The filled glass stands on its flat 7 cm base.

ideas.title: Jagermeister Orange Highball
ideas.pitch: Herbal liqueur lengthened with orange juice
Canadian whisky served over ice with cola
ideas.title: Crown Royal Cola Highball

ideas.pitch: Coconut rum lengthened with pineapple juice
ideas.title: Malibu Pineapple Cooler

steps.c: Place the empty highball glass on the counter
Add 2 ice cubes to the glass
Pour 50 ml Jägermeister over the ice
Pour 150 ml orange juice into the glass
Stir gently for 10 seconds to chill and mix
Place the orange slice on the rim
